notes: On 15 July 2025, joint forces comprising the Syrian Army, police, and tribal militias advanced into As-Sweida city (As-Sweida - Unspecified), taking control of several neighborhoods amid heavy shelling and clashes with Druze militias early in the day. By midday, a ceasefire was announced by leaders from Suwayda's Druze, Christian, and civil councils, who called on government forces to enter the city to restore order. Israeli airstrikes resumed shortly thereafter. In response, Druze militias launched a counteroffensive, regaining control of parts of the city. Intense skirmishes were reported around key sites, including the National Hospital and the police headquarters. Government forces were ambushed at multiple locations across the city. The Syrian Army also deployed Shahin drones during the clashes. Fighting continued into the following day, with neither side achieving full control over As-Sweida.
